summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.52/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.52 a gallon across Wisconsin as of July 3, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 9¢ lower than a week ago, 48¢ lower than a month ago, and 64¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.37) and the highest in Mosinee ($3.76).
